name: Web Fetch
author: Horizon Team
description: Fetch URLs and extract clean text from web pages — no API keys.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: GET an HTTP(S) URL and return the raw response body (HTML / JSON / text). Capped at 1 MB.

tools.name: extract_text
tools.description: Fetch a URL and strip HTML to plain text — useful for summarising articles, docs, READMEs.
